trace_roles: OFF docker E2E primary, ON/profiler/component and sampled residency diagnostic only; nested durations never summed as exclusive E2E shares

sr_eager.change: sr_compile_mode: reduce-overhead -> null; all other detector/model/threshold settings fixed
sr_eager.primary: trace OFF E2E, using retained compiled baseline as historical comparison; component ABBA paired screen for batch experiment
correctness_gates: ordered source-coordinate detector barline geometry identical
ordered base/final page/system/staff/measure geometry and numbers identical
page identities and MMR support geometry mappings identical
x4 HOMR detector geometry and staff/connector masks inspected for equality; differences fail strict source-semantic gate
sr_eager.full_acceptance: one-page result only, no production adoption without broader fixed semantic regression and fresh repeated E2E comparisons

sr_tile_batch2.change: tile batch size 1 -> 2 on current FP16/channels-last/GPU uint8/CPU-stitch implementation; eager mode fixed for both
sr_tile_batch2.input: same original page_013 and same selected weight
sr_tile_batch2.timing: first call separately; warmed ABBA page-enhance timings, CUDA sync before/after; init/serialization excluded and reported separately

advance_criteria.downstream: advance only if exact pixel identity plus sr_eager E2E source and downstream semantic gates pass; otherwise not adoption-ready

sr_tile_batch2.limits: eager microbenchmark is screening, not compiled-production E2E or permanent rejection of batching

cpu_profile.scope: one retained current-HOMR request and/or downstream replay, no new SR; profiler timing diagnostic only
cpu_profile.acceptance: no production mutation; compare reused versus replayed semantic artifacts

source_parallel.change: two independent source-page workers overlap; SR already materialized, each worker remains disposable
source_parallel.baseline: retained same inputs/requests/weights/SR from sequential multi-off-warm; component residency sampled at 0.2 s, comparison exploratory rather than controlled repeated causal E2E
gates: source original/x4 HOMR ordered predictions and decoded staff/connector masks identical
component wall at least 1.2x faster than sum of retained sequential source worker residencies
source_parallel.acceptance: source-component screen only; integration page/movement ordering, numbering/MMR/correction and full fixed regression not run, cannot adopt production based on this PoC

resource_observation: multi off sampled /proc,cgroup at 0.2 s plus docker stats; sampler adds CPU overhead, exact process start/end not instrumented; report first/last observation bounds and overlap
gpu_competition: record GPU process/device/container state before and throughout additional jobs; discard known overlap
